# DESIGN

**DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE. READ AND FOLLOW ONLY**

1. Do not use high border-radius. 4px, 8px maximum.
2. Do not use borders around cards, items. Use borders extremely sparingly. Any 2 items/elements next to each other should not both have borders ever.
3. You are only allowed to use `fractalstyler` classes. Use fractalstyler-mcp for guidance on what classes to use when.
4. You can also refer to `/Users/amrit/fractaldesign/packages/fractalstyler/registry.json`.
5. You are a guest in this project. Follow established conventions. For any styling, layout, ui, markup decision - first see whether existing standard is being used in the project for that.
6. Do not use gap-xs. At largest containers on pages, use gap-xl (when containers are `box` class), and second level use gap-lg, at 3rd level like cards use gap-bs. For items clamped closer, inside cards for example, like a heading and description in a `box` class, use `gap-md` or `gap-sm` on the box.

## Color Behaviour

- primary variant is default variant for components where its used - buttons, iconbuttons
- on light mode, dark greys/blacks for bg-button, and text-inverse for text on buttons
	- on dark mode, soft whites for bg, text-inverse on button

- secondary is soft, low contrast with main background. 
- themed paints bg in theme color, on light mode should be dark because text-inverse is white
	on dark mode text-primary, if theme color is still dark

- outline has dark border and text primary


## Canonical Layouts

**This is the canonical markup permitted**

```svelte
<div class="app-shell">
	<header class="app-header ycenter row xbetween wfull">
		<a class="logo-link row gap-bs ycenter"></a>
		<nav class="header-nav row gap-bs ycenter">
			<!--all links to be: -->
			<a href="...">link</a>
			toggles
			buttons
		</nav>
	</header>
	<main class="app-main">
		<aside class="sidebar-left py-xl">
			<nav class="nav-section box gap-bs">
				<p class="nav-header">...</p>
				<div class="box gap-bs">
					<!--each link: -->
					<a class="nav-link" href="...">
						...
					</a>
				</div>
			</nav>
		</aside>
		<section class="main-section">
			<section class="content-section narrow-full">
				<header class="page-header">
					<!--if breadcrumb: -->
					<Breadcrumb.../>
					<h1 class="page-title">title</h1>
					<p class="page-desc text-secondary lh16">desc</p>
				</header>
				<article class="box sitedocs gap-lg">
					....
				</article>
			</section> 
		</section>
		<aside class="sidebar-right py-xl">
			<nav class="toc-section box gap-bs">
				<p class="nav-header">On This Page</p>
				<!--each page indexed header: -->
				<a class="toc-link">...</a>
			</nav>
		</aside>
	</main>
	<!--use footer only if user asks. do not add footers on your own -->
	<footer class="app-footer ycenter row xbetween wfull"></footer>
</div>
````

Thsi layout is flexible, and can be used in different ways, BUT NEVER WITHOUT THIS HIERARCHY, AND NEVER WITH A DIFFERENT MARKUP.

### No sidebars layout:

At root layout:

```svelte
<div class="app-shell">
	<header class="app-header ycenter row xbetween wfull">
		<a class="logo-link row gap-bs ycenter"></a>
		<nav class="header-nav row gap-bs ycenter">
			<!--all links to be: -->
			<a href="...">link</a>
			toggles
			buttons
		</nav>
	</header>
	<main class="app-main">
		{@render children()} 
	</main>
	<!--use footer only if user asks. do not add footers on your own -->
	<footer class="app-footer ycenter row xbetween wfull"></footer>
</div>
```

Then on pages:

```svelte
<section class="main-section">
	<section class="content-section narrow-wide">
		...
	</section>
</section>
<!--for full width content on no sidebar layouts, use narrow-wide with content-section -->
<!-- on layouts with only left sidebar, use content-section narrow-half -->
```

### Other Canonicals.

Only this is permitted for page headers

```svelte
<header class="page-header">
	<!--if breadcrumb: -->
	<Breadcrumb.../>
	<h1 class="page-title">title</h1>
	<p class="page-desc text-secondary lh16">desc</p>
</header>
```

- h2 should be `text-heading-xl`. h2 to be `text-heading-lg`.
- body text to be `text-body-lg`, `text-body`, `text-body-sm` in that order of hierarchy.

Do not invent your own typography.

For cards, use `card-title` on title text and `card-desc` on description text. Put other elements inside a `<footer>` in the card.

`src/lib/styles/` is the source of truth for all styling: the fractalstyler layers live in this package now.

### Size
Fixed, do not change these values

```sass
	--unit-space: 0.25rem

	--space-xl: calc(var(--unit-space) * 8)

	--space-3xl: calc(var(--unit-space) * 16)
```

### Motion

```sass
	--transin1: cubic-bezier(0.470, 0.000, 0.745, 0.715)
	--transin2: cubic-bezier(0.550, 0.055, 0.675, 0.190)
	--transin3: cubic-bezier(0.755, 0.050, 0.855, 0.060)
	--transout1: cubic-bezier(0.390, 0.575, 0.565, 1.000)
	--transout2: cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.610, 0.355, 1.000)
	--transout3: cubic-bezier(0.230, 1.000, 0.320, 1.000)
	--speed0: 50ms
	--speed1: 90ms
	--speed2: 140ms
	--speed3: 220ms
	--motionin1: var(--speed0) var(--transin1)
	--motionout1: var(--speed1) var(--transout1)
	--motionin2: var(--speed2) var(--transin2)
	--motionout2: var(--speed2) var(--transout2)
	--motionin3: var(--speed3) var(--transin3)
	--motionout3: var(--speed3) var(--transout3)
```
